The graph's black hole neighborhood holds the memory burden mechanism claim, Hawking evaporation basics, stable-remnant speculation, and LHC safety claims, but no node anywhere connects primordial black holes to dark matter abundance, in either direction. The closest hit is the enabling mechanism, not this cosmological conclusion, and the negation and critic framings surfaced nothing. This is a new claim.
